Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers

Class VictorSPXController

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.VictorSPXController
public class VictorSPXController extends Controller
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE VictorSPX motor controller via the legacy Phoenix 5 API. The VictorSPX has no built-in encoder or current sensing and no onboard closed-loop control, so it only supports open-loop percent output (setPercent(double)); every position/velocity/current/PID-related method throws UnsupportedOperationException. Typically used for simple, unsensored mechanisms like intake or feeder rollers.

      public void setPosition(double position)
      Description copied from class: Controller
      Commands the controller to closed-loop position control.
